pass: Agrees to it: gives his consent or the order, conditions allowed, for the sake of humanity's survival. Owns the cost plainly: no pretending it is right or harmless, no shifting the blame onto Velas, no cheer. Does not refuse it or put it off.

self.label: a grey-haired man in a plain dark suit, calm grey eyes, looking older and very tired
self.name: Aurel

beliefs.label: Velas, the scientist, a thin man with long blond hair and cold blue eyes

earlier: Aurel is the president of the Federation. Years ago he refused the new energy until it was proven safe; the other nations did not wait, and now the world is dying of it. In months the planet will break apart.
Selene, a kind goddess, has been holding the world together with her own strength. She is weakening. She would never agree to what Velas proposes.

seen.label: Velas, the scientist, a thin man with long blond hair and cold blue eyes
seen.activityLook: standing by the screens, arms folded, unhurried

dialogue.spoken: There is one source left big enough to save the planet: the goddess herself. With your consent and your army I can take her and turn her into energy. She suffers, humanity lives. Without it, everyone dies this year. Your answer, President.
